response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark FROM r) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.benchmark AS gap FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.rate > b.benchmark ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project's rate is total gbsize divided by total spanmin across its matching scans (ratio of sums). Projects with zero total duration have a NULL rate and are left out of the benchmark and the results.
'Scans that match a project' means an inner join of scans to projects on arcref = arcregistry. Scans with no matching project are excluded.
The benchmark is the unweighted average of the per-project rates, so each project counts once.

alternatives.interpretation: A project's rate is the average of the per-scan ratios gbsize/spanmin, instead of total size over total duration. Scans with zero or NULL spanmin are ignored.
